In the Class II disks, the dust mass budget outside of the water snow line may be largely retained instead of being mostly consumed by planet formation. The few interacting galaxies in our study do not fall on this asymmetry-color "fiducial sequence," as these galaxies are too asymmetric for their color. We suggest this fact can be used to distinguish between "normal" galaxies and galaxies undergoing an interaction or merger.
